cases.note: formatOptions only falls back to the 2-decimal default when the options object is absent, whereas the original also fell back when options.decimalPlaces was undefined. With options present but decimalPlaces omitted, toFixed(undefined) acts as toFixed(0), so e.g. bytes.format(1536, {}) now returns '2KB' instead of '1.5KB'.

cases.note: The refactor rewrote the core int explicit-tag pattern's first alternative from [-+]?0b[0-1]+ to [^-+]?0b[0-1]+ (negated character class), so signed binary literals no longer match. Under the default CORE_SCHEMA, load('!!int -0b101') used to return -5 and now throws 'cannot resolve a node with !<tag:yaml.org,2002:int> explicit tag'.

cases.note: The LONG_UNITS loop is an equivalent refactor, but pluralize changed the pluralization threshold from msAbs >= n * 1.5 to msAbs > n * 1.5. At exactly 1.5 units (e.g. 1500 ms) Math.round rounds to 2 and the original emitted the plural form ('2 seconds'), while the patched build emits the singular ('2 second').
